thought.text: Let me look at the structure around those specific ports.

reasoning_content: I'm realizing the grep context might not be capturing the service name properly since the structure could have the name appearing before the command. Let me check what's actually in the file around those specific lines to understand the layout better.

action.command:
cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008 18014; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port (line $line) ==="
  sed -n "$((line-45)),$((line))p" process-compose.yaml | grep -E 'name:|image:|directory:' | tail -4
done
